Appearance

Java-native · Private & auditable · No cloud lock-in

Enterprise Agent OS

OryxOS runs on your own K8s, servers, or bare metal — a unified base for all your business agents. One shared set of channels, model routing, tools, memory, and sandbox. Data never leaves your infrastructure.

Get Started → Technical Solution GitHub
JDK 21 · Spring Boot 3.x · Self-implemented ReAct loop · SQLite audit · MCP · Picocli · Single fat JAR

Why OryxOS

The open-source agent ecosystem has OpenClaw (Node.js) and Hermes Agent (Python), but no Java project positions itself as an Agent OS — yet Java is the de-facto standard in enterprise backends.

① Data must stay inside the enterprise? Private deployment, fully auditable, fits existing IT governance.

② How do you integrate with existing Java systems? A standard Spring Boot project that plugs straight into your Java stack; tools are MCP — writable in any language.

OryxOS fills exactly that gap: a Java-native, run-and-done, auditable Agent runtime that passes enterprise security review.

Today
✗Node.js / Python agents need glue code into the Java backend
✗Private auditability requires re-hardening
✗No multi-tenancy / SSO / full audit
✗Data tied to cloud ecosystems

Architecture

Modular monolith, single-binary delivery

Five Core Capabilities

The five pillars of the runtime kernel

🤖

LLM Providers

Provider abstraction · explicit model mapping · runtime switch

# 一个 Profile 对应一个 Agent（YAML）
# .oryxos/profiles/ops-assistant.yaml
name: ops-assistant
description: 企业运维助手
provider:
  name: deepseek      # 或 qwen / kimi / anthropic / openai ...
  model: deepseek-chat
tools:
  - http_get
  - shell
  - read_file
channels:
  - cli
settings:
  max_iterations: 10
🔄

ReAct Loop

Self-implemented loop · Reason + Act · multi-step tool use

# Agent 核心循环（约数十行 Java）
# 组装 Prompt → 调 LLM → 有 Tool 调用？
#   否 → 返回最终响应
#   是 → 执行 Tool → 结果追加历史 → 继续循环
# MAX_ITERATIONS 默认 10 次，防死循环

用户 > 查一下北京天气并告诉我穿什么
Agent: 北京今天 24°C，多云，适合穿薄长袖或短袖加外套……
🧠

Three-layer Memory

Session · long-term · unified facade

# MemoryService 对 ReAct 只暴露一个接口
# 会话记忆  → SQLite（SessionManager）
# 长期记忆  → .oryxos/memory/MEMORY.md
#   内置 Tool: save_memory / recall_memory
#   接口预留向量检索升级空间

# 第一次对话：记住用户偏好
> 记住我喜欢用简洁风格回复
# 下次对话：自动 recall 并应用
Agent: 好的，后续回复保持简洁。
🛠️

Tool System

Built-in · MCP no-code · three tiers

# 零代码：SKILL.md + MCP
#   .oryxos/skills/daily-pr-digest.md
#   mcp_servers.yaml 配 github-mcp / slack-mcp
#   Profile 引用 Skill + MCP server → 完成

# 轻代码：自写 MCP server（任何语言）
# 重代码：@Tool 注解（Spring Bean）

# 沙箱白名单（SandboxChecker）：
#   文件路径 / Shell 命令 / HTTP 域名
🌐

Web Service

10 REST endpoints · the only gateway for business systems

# 创建会话
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/sessions \

  -d '{"profile_name": "ops-assistant"}'

curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/sessions/{id}/messages \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

Enterprise DNA

Day-one design

🔒

Private & Auditable

Data and deployment stay entirely in your hands. Every LLM call and tool invocation is written to SQLite audit tables from day one.

🛡️

Sandbox Whitelist

Three-tier whitelist for file paths, shell commands, and HTTP domains — app-layer isolation without the deprecated SecurityManager.

🔑

No Credentials at Rest

API keys load via environment variables or separate config — never hardcoded in profiles.

📦

Single Binary

JDK 21 + Spring Boot 3.x monolith — one fat JAR from mvn clean package. Deploys like any Spring Boot app.

Real Scenarios

Many business agents, one shared base

01

Ops Assistant

Alert triage, log queries, service restarts. Via CLI or REST API — concise, professional replies.

02

Customer Support

Customer-support Agent on the shared base: multi-turn chat, ticketing tools, long-term memory of customer preferences.

03

HR Assistant

Policy Q&A, leave queries. Integrates into your existing OA systems over HTTP.

04

Sales Assistant

Contact cleanup, pitch generation, follow-up reminders. Multiple agents share the same channel and memory base.

05

Knowledge Assistant

Document retrieval, FAQ maintenance. Extend with new SKILL.md + MCP scenarios with zero code.

06

One Shared Base

All agents share one set of channels, model routing, tools, memory, and sandbox — adding an Agent is just one more Profile.

Start Building

Requires JDK 21+ and Maven 3.9+. Get a runnable Agent runtime in a minute.

git clone https://github.com/txw-github/oryxos.git
cd oryxos
mvn clean package

# 初始化工作区
java -jar oryxos-boot/target/oryxos.jar init

# 配置 Provider（环境变量注入 API key）
export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-xxxx

# 与 Agent 对话
java -jar oryxos-boot/target/oryxos.jar chat

# 启动 HTTP 服务
java -jar oryxos-boot/target/oryxos.jar serve   # 默认 8080
